Rules.Name: agriconnect-daily-update
Rules.Description: Trigger daily data collection and prediction refresh at 6 AM IST

Rules.Name: agriconnect-weekly-retrain
Rules.Description: Trigger weekly model retraining on Sundays at 2 AM IST

Notes.daily_update: Cron uses UTC. 0 0 UTC = 5:30 AM IST (6 AM IST during IST)
Notes.weekly_retrain: 0 20 UTC = 1:30 AM IST Sunday (2 AM IST)
Notes.replace_ACCOUNT: Replace with your AWS account ID
Notes.lambda_arns: Update ARNs after deploying Lambda functions
